blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Telecommunications Commission (NTC) has blocked two websites allegedly being used by “groomers” to encourage minors to commit real-world crimes after authorities cited a possible link between these and recent cases of school violence, including three on-campus shootings this year that left eight students dead and at least 28 wounded.
